correctness.rationale: Adjunction and nef anticanonical fiber force negative curves to be precisely nine Mordell–Weil sections (Shioda–Tate rank zero and torsion order nine) and twelve I_3 fiber components. All forbidden negative supports are the four incidence-pattern obstructions, whose selected intersection forms have singular principal submatrices; all remaining components are small positive-definite chains. Independent complete 2^21 mask enumeration using affine F_3 point-line incidence reproduced coefficients (1,21,210,1236,4497,10308,14772,12612,5634,874), summing to 50165; unlike a timeout it is exhaustive. Geometric exhaustion is a separate proof step.
